name: Dromarch
description: (Tag:character)(Tag:fighter)(Tag:large-size)(Tag:linked)(Tag:water)(Character)Dromarch is a Blade from a Core Crystal bound to their Driver, wielding Twin Rings with the Water Element. He combines powerful physique, healing, and Water mastery, and can be ridden as a mount. He grants his Driver a portion of abilities and armament when manifested, requires user energy, and scales with user strength and bond.
